string-array.name: guidance_1_en
string-array.item: Plant Setup and Establishment
A newly planted cutting has no clear new growth yet.
Plant a healthy, healed cutting in well-drained soil beside a sturdy support. Water lightly and introduce direct sun gradually.
Variety, cutting source, planting date, plot or post, watering, and first new shoot.
Soft or rotting tissue, standing water, unstable support, or sunburn.
Epic Gardening propagation sequence; UF IFAS Extension; University of Guam Extension.

string-array.name: guidance_1_fil
string-array.item: Pagtatanim at pagtatatag
Bagong tanim ang pinagputulan at wala pang malinaw na bagong tubo.
Itanim ang malusog at naghilom na pinagputulan sa lupang madaling magpaagos ng tubig, sa tabi ng matibay na suporta. Bahagyang diligan at unti-unting ilantad sa araw.
Barayti, pinagmulan, petsa ng pagtatanim, plot o poste, pagdidilig, at unang bagong sanga.
Malambot o nabubulok na bahagi, naipong tubig, mahinang suporta, o paso sa araw.
Epic Gardening propagation sequence; UF IFAS Extension; University of Guam Extension.

string-array.name: guidance_2_en
string-array.item: Shoot Development and Vertical Training
Green shoots are growing upward but have not reached the support\'s top.
Guide a healthy main shoot upward and tie it loosely. Follow the farm\'s watering and fertilizer plan.
Shoot growth, tying and pruning dates, watering, and fertilizer used.
Ties cutting into stems, broken shoots, wilting, yellowing, or spreading lesions.
Epic Gardening training steps; Philippine ATI guide; UF IFAS Extension; University of Guam Extension; Philippine stem canker studies.

string-array.name: guidance_2_fil
string-array.item: Paglaki at patayong paggabay
Humahaba ang luntiang sanga ngunit hindi pa naaabot ang tuktok ng suporta.
Igabay paitaas ang malusog na pangunahing sanga at itali nang maluwag. Sundin ang plano ng bukid sa tubig at pataba.
Paglaki ng sanga, petsa ng pagtali at pagputol, pagdidilig, at patabang ginamit.
Taling humihiwa sa tangkay, nabaling sanga, pagkalanta, paninilaw, o kumakalat na sugat.
Epic Gardening training steps; Philippine ATI guide; UF IFAS Extension; University of Guam Extension; Philippine stem canker studies.

string-array.name: guidance_3_en
string-array.item: Canopy Formation and Maintenance
The main shoot has reached the top and new branches are spreading or hanging down.
Keep healthy hanging branches. Remove dead, damaged, diseased, or crowded growth with clean tools. Tip the main shoot only if this is farm practice.
Pruning date, branches kept or removed, reason, and photos.
Weak support, broken branches, persistent wet crowding, sunburn, or spreading lesions.
Epic Gardening pruning sequence; Philippine ATI guide; UF IFAS Extension; University of Guam Extension; 2024 strategic pruning study; Philippine disease literature.

string-array.name: guidance_3_fil
string-array.item: Pagbuo at pangangalaga ng mga sanga
Naabot ng pangunahing sanga ang tuktok at may kumakalat o nakalaylay nang mga sanga.

Panatilihin ang malusog na nakalaylay na sanga. Alisin ang patay, napinsala, may sakit, o sobrang siksik na bahagi gamit ang malinis na kagamitan. Putulin lamang ang dulo kung pamamaraan ito ng bukid.
Petsa ng pagputol, mga sangang pinili o inalis, dahilan, at larawan.
Mahinang suporta, nabaling sanga, basang siksikan, paso sa araw, o kumakalat na sugat.
Epic Gardening pruning sequence; Philippine ATI guide; UF IFAS Extension; University of Guam Extension; 2024 strategic pruning study; Philippine disease literature.

string-array.name: guidance_4_en
string-array.item: Flower Bud Development
A swelling on a stem is becoming a flower bud.
Count and mark buds, set the next check, and prepare the variety\'s pollination plan.
First bud date, bud count, plant or post, variety, weather, and photo.
Bud drop, insect damage, rot, or lesions near buds.
Epic Gardening bud tracking; dragon fruit BBCH phenology study.

string-array.name: guidance_4_fil
string-array.item: Paglabas ng usbong ng bulaklak
Ang namamagang bahagi sa sanga ay nagiging usbong ng bulaklak.
Bilangin at markahan ang mga usbong, itakda ang susunod na pagsusuri, at ihanda ang plano sa polinasyon ng barayti.
Petsa ng unang usbong, bilang, halaman o poste, barayti, panahon, at larawan.
Pagkalaglag ng usbong, pinsala ng insekto, pagkabulok, o sugat malapit sa usbong.
Epic Gardening bud tracking; dragon fruit BBCH phenology study.

string-array.name: guidance_5_en
string-array.item: Flowering and Pollination
A flower opens at night or is still open at dawn.
Check the flower while open. Follow verified variety-specific pollination needs; hand- or cross-pollinate when needed.
Opening date and time, method, pollen source, flowers pollinated, weather, and photo.
Rain during pollination, unsuitable pollen, flower damage, or no fruit growth afterward.
Epic Gardening flower reminder; UF IFAS Extension; University of Guam Extension; 2025 pollination biology study.

string-array.name: guidance_5_fil
string-array.item: Pamumulaklak at polinasyon
Bumubuka ang bulaklak sa gabi o nakabuka pa ito sa madaling araw.
Suriin ang bulaklak habang nakabuka. Sundin ang beripikadong pangangailangan sa polinasyon ng barayti; magsagawa ng manwal o cross-pollination kung kailangan.
Petsa at oras ng pagbuka, paraan, pinagmulan ng pollen, bilang ng napolinahan, panahon, at larawan.
Ulan habang nagpopolinasyon, hindi angkop na pollen, pinsala sa bulaklak, o hindi paglaki ng bunga pagkatapos.
Epic Gardening flower reminder; UF IFAS Extension; University of Guam Extension; 2025 pollination biology study.

string-array.name: guidance_6_en
string-array.item: Fruit Set and Development
The flower has wilted and a green fruit is starting to enlarge.
Confirm fruit set, count and mark developing fruit, and keep soil evenly moist without waterlogging.
Fruit-set date, fruit count, watering or rain, damage, next check, and photos.
Fruit drop, cracking, pest damage, sunburn, or soft rot.
Epic Gardening fruit set sequence; Philippine ATI guide; University of Guam Extension; Philippine disease literature.

string-array.name: guidance_6_fil
string-array.item: Pagbuo at paglaki ng bunga
Nalanta ang bulaklak at lumalaki ang luntiang bunga.
Tiyaking nabuo ang bunga, bilangin at markahan ito, at panatilihing pantay ang halumigmig nang walang pagbabara ng tubig.
Petsa ng pagbuo, bilang ng bunga, pagdidilig o ulan, pinsala, susunod na pagsusuri, at larawan.
Pagkalaglag, bitak, pinsala ng peste, paso sa araw, o malambot na pagkabulok.
Epic Gardening fruit set sequence; Philippine ATI guide; University of Guam Extension; Philippine disease literature.

string-array.name: guidance_7_en
string-array.item: Maturity and Harvest
The skin is changing toward the ripe color for its variety.
Check color and condition together with days since flowering. Harvest only when fruit meets the farm\'s market standard.
Flowering and harvest dates, color, weight, grade, defects, destination, and photo.
Early or delayed harvest, shriveling, cracks, pests, or rot.
Epic Gardening harvest sequence; UF IFAS Extension; red and white fleshed dragon fruit maturity studies.

string-array.name: guidance_7_fil
string-array.item: Paghinog at pag-aani
Nagbabago ang balat tungo sa hinog na kulay ng barayti.
Suriin ang kulay at kalagayan kasama ang araw mula sa pamumulaklak. Anihin lamang kung pasado sa pamantayan ng bukid at pamilihan.
Petsa ng pamumulaklak at ani, kulay, timbang, grado, depekto, patutunguhan, at larawan.
Masyadong maaga o huling ani, pagkalanta, bitak, peste, o pagkabulok.
Epic Gardening harvest sequence; UF IFAS Extension; red and white fleshed dragon fruit maturity studies.

string-array.name: guidance_8_en
string-array.item: Postharvest and Cycle Review
Harvest for this cycle is complete.
Record the harvest, clean tools, safely remove or isolate suspect diseased material, and plan the next cycle.
Total count and weight, grades, rejected fruit and reasons, pruning, and next-cycle notes.
Disease left on plants, dirty tools, damaged supports, repeat losses, or missing records.
Philippine ATI guide; UF IFAS Extension; 2024 pruning study; digital farm recordkeeping review; FAO integrated pest management guidance.

string-array.name: guidance_8_fil
string-array.item: Pagkatapos ng ani at pagsusuri ng siklo
Tapos na ang pag-aani para sa siklong ito.
Itala ang ani, linisin ang kagamitan, ligtas na alisin o ihiwalay ang pinaghihinalaang may sakit na bahagi, at planuhin ang susunod na siklo.
Kabuuang bilang at timbang, mga grado, hindi tinanggap na bunga at dahilan, pagputol, at tala para sa susunod na siklo.
Naiwang may sakit na bahagi, maruming kagamitan, sirang suporta, paulit-ulit na pagkawala, o kulang na tala.
Philippine ATI guide; UF IFAS Extension; 2024 pruning study; digital farm recordkeeping review; FAO integrated pest management guidance.
